dye_legend.rule: step k = round(-log2(share of descent)), 0 to 4; a share of 0 is warm grey

mapping.azimuth: houses west to east by longitude, sector angle proportional to 2 + people (4 degree gaps), the eldest founder's house (Habsburg main line) at azimuth 0 (+Z)
mapping.dye: the contract's dye colours, stepped by generations of descent from the founders: step k = round(-log2(share)), 0 to 4, drawn as the tapestry's colour at the equivalent share 1 - k/8 (deeper = closer; 1/16 or less is floored at the tapestry's 1/2 colour); a share of 0 (no descent in the data, in-laws) is ecru
mapping.elevation: layout only: inside a house, depth-first order of descent (children by birth, in-laws beside their spouse) from top to bottom
mapping.fiber: a life runs radially from r(born) to r(died); a spawn arc on the birth shell joins it to a parent; a move bends it along the shell of the move year (dotted when the year is not in the data); a death not in the data is dashed after the last dated event, to the tapestry's 60-year end
mapping.focus: on a close shot (CU, MCU) or a pick the subject's threads burn brightest, the line back to the founders stays lit (at most 32 people: the main line by the larger share of descent, the other parent at each step, then other ancestors) and every other thread dims to a fifth; a bead marks the stop's event, ringed when it is a marriage (drawn at the middle of the arc)
lines: Radius = time: 1200 at the core, 1925 at the glass, 755.2 years per pocket unit, shells every 50 years. Azimuth: houses west to east, angle = 2 + people. Elevation: order of descent (layout only).
Each life a fiber, each marriage an arc on the shell of its year.
mapping.marriage: an arc on the shell of the wedding year between the spouses' fibers; a close marriage (phi > 0) is doubled and brighter in the dye; an estimated year is dashed and translucent
mapping.nesting: the pocket sits in its host at scale 6: 1 pocket unit = 6 host units; a century = 0.79 host units
mapping.radius: r(year) = 0.08 + (year - 1200) x 0.001324 pocket units: 1200 at the seed edge, 1925 at r 1.04 just inside the glass (r 1.1); 755.2 years per pocket unit; time shells every 50 years from 1250
mapping.root: a founder's root line from the seed to their birth point is layout only (no years of life)
mapping.short: Radius = time: 1200 at the core, 1925 at the glass, 755.2 years per pocket unit, shells every 50 years. Azimuth: houses west to east, angle = 2 + people. Elevation: order of descent (layout only).

gold = descended from the founders (deeper = closer); warm grey = none; dashed = an estimated year.

narration.text: A sphere of time: the founders sit at the centre (1200), the present is the glass (1925). Each life is a fiber running outward from birth to death; each marriage is an arc on the shell of its year.

computed.text: Founders of the dye: habsburg (#b8860b): Rudolf I of Germany 1218–1291 and Gertrude of Hohenberg 1225–1281.
8 children of the founders are in the file, born 1253–1271.

The first moves between houses: Albert I from Habsburg main line to Austria, on the 1279? marriage; Rudolf II from Habsburg main line to Austria, on the 1289 marriage; Leopold III from Austria to Leopoldine (Styrian) line, on the 1369? marriage; Albert III from Austria to Albertine line, on the 1375 marriage; Frederick IV from Leopoldine (Styrian) line to Leopoldine (Tyrolean) line, on the 1407? marriage; Maximilian I from Leopoldine (Styrian) line to Austria, on the 1477? marriage.
A move rides the wedding arc when the spouse was already in that house; a dotted move has no year in the data.
The 1672 marriage (year estimated: not in the data): Leopold I and Margaret Theresa of Spain, uncle-nephew/niece, kinship φ = 0.2610, drawn doubled.
No children of theirs in the file.
8 of the 39 marriages in this file are close (the couple share founders in the data), 1548–1801; each is drawn doubled. 8 of those years are not in the data and are drawn at an estimate (marked ?).
Fibers that cross on a close marriage: 5 brides, 0 grooms.

The file has no closing dates. Its "closed" year per house is the last death among the house's core members: Habsburg main line 1322; Leopoldine (Tyrolean) line 1496; Albertine line 1505; Leopoldine (Styrian) line 1520; Spain 1700; Austria 1916.
Where that differs from a narrated closing, the data list (data-issues.json) records it; the sphere does not.
